name: ARZWP Integration for Payhip and E-Commerce
author: ARZWP

sections.description:
After configuring the plugin, place your Payhip product link on your WordPress page. After the user clicks on the link, the Payhip checkout page will be displayed, and (the user’s order will be automatically added to WooCommerce orders after completing the payment. If the user is not a member of your website, the plugin will automatically register the user. Pro)

🗝️ Key Free features:

  • Automatically open the Payhip checkout page on WordPress pages.
  • Automatically display the Payhip quick buy button on the Woocommerce product details page.

🗝️ Key [Pro](https://arzwp.shop/connect-payhip-with-woocommerce/#pricing) features:

  • [Automatically send Payhip orders to WooCommerce orders]: The user’s order will be automatically added to WooCommerce orders after completing the payment.
  • [Custom Shortcode]: Display Payhip quick buy button on any page using WooPayhip shortcode.

External services

This plugin utilizes the Payhip JavaScript API to obtain payment information.
This service is provided by “Payhip INC”: terms of use, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or Extract the zip file and drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Woocommerce > WooPayhip to see the plugin’s settings page
  4. Customize settings and hit the save button.
  5. Now go to the WooCommerce product’s edit screen and under the product’s data tab, find the WooPayhip tab and enter your Payhip product URL in the field to map with the WooCommerce product and hit the update button to apply changes.
  6. Visit the product’s page to see the buy now button, which will automatically open the Payhip checkout form after clicking.
